description: [Merchant] Download a READY export file (production only). A text export (CSV, HTML, XML) is previewed; with saveToFile the file is written to payware-mcp-downloads in the system temp directory and the result names its path. A binary export (PDF, XLS(X), DOCX, ODT, ODS, RTF) needs saveToFile.

exportId.description: The export ID from the export request (UUID format)

partnerId.description: Partner ID from payware dashboard. Uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

privateKey.description: RSA private key for authentication. Uses the production private key as default (reports run on production only).

saveToFile.description: Save the file to payware-mcp-downloads in the system temp directory and return its path. Without it a text export is previewed and a binary one only described.

name: payware_data_download_export
